name: parked-prompts-monorepo
description: Save chat prompts with their files and images for later, without sending them.

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm check:site
scripts.test:vscode: pnpm --filter @parked-prompts/core build && pnpm --filter parked-prompts build && pnpm --filter parked-prompts test:vscode
